content: In addition to those machine translation tasks, both traditional approaches and deep learning approaches must solve a word sequence tagging problem. Of the traditional approaches, contextual features around the considered word were used to predict following punctuation in the n-gram BIBREF32 and CRF model approaches BIBREF33 , BIBREF34 . Meanwhile, in the deep learning approaches, a deep convolutional neural network BIBREF35 , T-LSTM (Textual-LSTM) BIBREF26 and a bidirectional LSTM model with an attention mechanism, called T-BRNN BIBREF36 , have been adopted to predict a punctuation sequence from the word sequence. T-BRNN BIBREF36 was proposed to solve the task as a word-sequence tagging problem, and it is currently the best model that uses the word sequence tagging approach. Tilk O. et al. BIBREF36 also proposed a variant named T-BRNN-pre, which integrates pretrained word vectors to improve the accuracy.
